answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded collateral escrows: when evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, the base penalty grows quadratically, O(k²), rather than treating each signer independently. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes slashed bonds recover value more slowly than honest collateral. A relic, raven, and dune may be separate labels, but labels do not divide shared risk or soften the cost of a coordinated swarm.
